Galliford Try appointed to £5.0 billion Pagabo Major Works framework
Galliford Try, a leading UK construction group, announces that it has been appointed to the £5.0 billion Pagabo National Framework for Major Works.

The business has been awarded places on Lot 4 (projects valued from £30 million to £60 million) across the South West, South East, and London regions and Lot 5 (in excess of £60 million) for Scotland. The framework will run for a four-year term and covers public sector buildings and facilities for local authorities and other public bodies across the UK.

Bill Hocking, Chief Executive for Galliford Try, commented: "Having been recently appointed to Pagabo's Infrastructure framework, we are delighted to be working with them once again on this important public sector framework. We look forward to collaborating together to deliver high-quality facilities for communities across the country."
Kevin Corbett, General Counsel & Company Secretary

Galliford Try Holdings plc is a leading UK construction group listed on the London Stock Exchange, and a member of the FTSE 250. Operating as Galliford Try and Morrison Construction, the group carries out building and infrastructure projects with clients in the public, private and regulated sectors across the UK.
